cause.label: dilution_or_going_concern
cause.what_happened: This is the fifth straight session lower for a ~$1.5m-market-cap shipping microcap. It ran from about $6 to a $14.31 intraday high after its second 25-for-1 reverse split (effective 2026-09-17) and has since lost about 90%. In the same stretch the CEO took 1,625,000 Class B shares at $0.40 on 2026-09-25 (13D/A filed 2026-09-30), lifting her voting power from 44.8% to 99.3%. No company news is dated 2026-10-01; today's -7% came on 0.67x normal volume with no gap.

positioning_check: Nasdaq short interest at the 2026-09-15 settlement was 3,134,393 shares, days to cover 1.0. That was before the 25:1 split, so it is about 125k post-split shares, roughly 12% of the 1.02m Class A shares. It is up from 59,956 at 2026-08-31 (https://api.nasdaq.com/api/quote/NCT/short-interest?assetclass=stocks). FINRA lags about eight business days, so the position carried into today's fall cannot be seen. There is no options market, so no skew.

findings.finding: Warrants from the July 2026 best-efforts unit offering (8,000,000 pre-split units at $0.79, one warrant each) carry a zero-exercise-price option for two Class A shares per warrant and stay exercisable for six months from issuance, so share supply can arrive on any session in the window, 2026-10-02 included. How many are left unexercised could not be established.
findings.mechanism_in_window: There is no exercise date: holders can convert and sell on any session through about January 2027, so 2026-10-02 is covered. It is standing supply, not a dated event, and it is weighted low for that reason.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the reverse split took effect the stock closed lower the next session after 8 of its 12 September falls of 5% or more (baseline history: -21.1, -18.75, -2.77, +2.39, +18.52, -7.01, +5.26, -14.36, -4.73, -24.4, -17.46, -7.05), which fits supply meeting every bounce.
findings.why_not_priced: A -7% day on 0.67x volume is a drift, not a flush, so the supply this overhang can still deliver has not been forced out in one print. If the price held it, today would show a capitulation-volume low. The 25.4m pre-split share count on 2026-09-14 suggests much of the 16m-share zero-price pool may already have converted, which is why this carries a small weight.
findings.independence: The 2026-09-15 short-interest settlement rose 52x over 2026-08-31 (https://api.nasdaq.com/api/quote/NCT/short-interest?assetclass=stocks): consistent with traders hedging or shorting into warrant supply, but this is a proxy.

outside_window.finding: Two 25:1 reverse splits in 2026 (effective 2026-04-02 and 2026-09-17), cumulative 625:1. If the bid falls back under $1 the company may not get a new compliance period; any Nasdaq determination would need 30 business days below $1, so it cannot land by 2026-10-02.
